articles.headline: Arsenal hold on for a big win at Liverpool, one Iraola & Co. can learn from
articles.description: Arsenal's defense held firm against the Reds' expensive attack to notch a famous win at Anfield for the first time since 2012. However, there were positive signs for Liverpool when it came to their intensity and effort.

articles.headline: Kai Havertz becomes all-time record German goalscorer in Premier League
articles.description: Kai Havertz's winning goal in Arsenal's 1-0 triumph at Liverpool on Sunday made him the record German goalscorer in the Premier League.

articles.headline: Premier League VAR review: Liverpool denied a penalty vs. Arsenal?
articles.description: VAR often causes controversy, but how are decisions made? Our resident ref, Andy Davies, explains all.

articles.headline: Premier League recap: Arsenal beat Liverpool 1-0 in thrilling game
articles.description: Kai Havertz's early goal proved enough as Arsenal held on to beat Liverpool 1-0 at Anfield on Sunday. Here's all the action as it happened.

articles.headline: Arsenal hold off Liverpool for first win at Anfield since 2012
articles.description: Arsenal recorded a first Premier League win at Anfield in 16 years but needed some help from Liverpool goalkeeper Alisson Becker, whose first-half error led to Kai Havertz's solitary goal in the 1-0 win.
